item.title: Write Narration From The Clip

turns.text: Watch this and write a short English voice-over explaining what's happening. Replace the original conversation with your narration, friendly and matter-of-fact. Keep all 10 seconds of footage unchanged, with no music or captions. You pick the wording and voice.

item.tests: Tests deriving a grounded narration from an attached clip and delivering it mixed into the original video with the original dialogue removed.

answer_sheet.What the narration should describe: The two coworkers discussing the new schedule, including the Monday start time of nine.
answer_sheet.Original sound: Remove the original conversation and replace it with narration.
answer_sheet.Video duration and framing: Keep all 10 seconds and preserve the source framing and sequence.
answer_sheet.Music, captions, and lip synchronization: No music or captions; do not alter the footage to match the narrator's mouth movements.

must_haves: The final video retains the original two coworkers, office setting, shot sequence, and 10-second duration.
An intelligible English narrator explains that the coworkers are discussing a schedule change and that Mondays now start at nine.
The narration does not invent names, job roles, or additional schedule changes unsupported by the clip.
The original man-and-woman conversation is no longer audible beneath the narration.
The narration fits within the video without a clipped ending, and no music or captions are added.

goal.quote: Replace the original conversation with your narration
goal.why: The request modifies the audio of a supplied video while preserving its footage.

plan.say: I'll inspect the footage, write a short narration describing what happens, and use a friendly English voice to replace the conversation. I'll keep all 10 seconds of footage unchanged, with no music or captions.

params.prompt_or_change: Inspect all 10 seconds and describe the visible actions in order, distinguishing observable facts from uncertain interpretations.

steps.why: Establish what visibly happens before writing an accurate narration.

params.extra: Language: English; approximately 18–22 words, comfortably spoken within 10 seconds.
params.prompt_or_change: Write only a short, friendly, matter-of-fact voice-over explaining the observed action; do not invent dialogue, motives, or uncertain details.

steps.why: Choose concise wording grounded in the actual footage.

params.extra: English; warm, clear adult voice; natural conversational delivery; fit the complete narration within 10 seconds.
params.prompt_or_change: Read the supplied narration in a friendly, matter-of-fact voice, with no music or other added sounds.

steps.why: Create the replacement spoken track with a voice chosen for the requested tone.

params.extra: Audio-only replacement; preserve original video frames and timing. Align narration at the start and pad any remaining audio time with silence.
params.prompt_or_change: Replace the original audio with narration.wav across the full 10-second clip; keep all footage unchanged and add no music or captions.

steps.why: Replace the original conversation without changing any footage.
